snippet.title: Chulip | Kissing Around Town [PS2] [Gameplay]
snippet.description:
A little gameplay from Chulip on PlayStation 2.

Wander around town, meet strange people, and try to kiss them.

Fun game.

---

🎮 *Game Info*

Chulip is a quirky adventure game built around exploring town, getting to know its residents, and finding opportunities to kiss them.

*Game:* Chulip
*Platform:* PlayStation 2
*Genre:* Adventure
*Players:* Single-player
